# KPC repository instructions

Read and follow the root `AGENTS.md` before making changes. It is the canonical source for this project's AI coding instructions.

For UI tasks, inspect the actual reference images indexed in `docs/ui-ux/README.md` and the global UI kit. Preserve the approved layouts, page routing, and components listed in `AGENTS.md`. Feature work, refactoring, backend integration, and merge resolution must not substitute another visual design. Keep changes simple and verify the result against the references.
